name: Ash
epithet: The grey hound from the House kennels
appearance: A grey wolfhound bitch, long-boned, all rib and shoulder, with a rough, wiry grey coat gone darker along the back, yellow eyes, a grizzled beard and folded ears. Her hind leg is splinted in pine laths and linen, the hair worn off around it. Her lip comes up off her teeth with no sound at all before she bites.
portrait_alt: Portrait of Ash in Book II: the lean grey wolfhound trotting toward the viewer on a frozen, rutted road between snowy dry-stone walls, ears up and mouth open in a grin, her hind leg still splinted in laths and linen.

portraits_earlier.label: Book I
portraits_earlier.portrait_alt: Portrait of Ash: a gaunt grey wolfhound with a rough, wiry coat, ribs showing, yellow eyes and bared teeth, standing on wet cobbles by a stone wall and straw, her hind leg bound in wooden laths and linen.

last_seen_doing: Walked close to the cart all morning.
now: Beside the cart on the drove road.
story_so_far: A grey hound with a splinted leg who bit the Captain, slept across his boot, and came off the kennel bars to the name Ash. She lies across every door with somebody behind it, and does not fetch.

known_facts.fact: She takes meat only from the Captain's left hand, with his right out of her sight.
known_facts.evidence: She would take from the Captain's left, and only with the right out of her sight

known_facts.fact: She growls at the grate in the kennel run, which the kennel-master says drains to the old cellars.
known_facts.evidence: "Drain," said the kennel-master. "Runs to the old cellars. She does that."

known_facts.fact: Maelis judged her a wolfhound that somebody once fed well, whose leg will take her weight by the thaw if she does not run on it.
known_facts.evidence: That's a wolfhound. Somebody fed her well, once.

known_facts.fact: She came off the bars to the name Ash and lay down with her splint across the Captain's boot.
known_facts.evidence: lay down against him with the new splint across his boot

known_facts.fact: She took the fifth knucklebone when it went off the blanket and kept it under the Captain's cot.
known_facts.evidence: There was a small, satisfied sound from under the cot, and then the sound of something being chewed with great care.

known_facts.fact: She came to the cloister a length behind the Captain's heel with the fifth knucklebone in her mouth.
known_facts.evidence: with the dog a length behind his heel and the fifth bone in her mouth

known_facts.fact: When the Captain's sword skittered into the arcade she put a foot on it and would not bring it to him.
known_facts.evidence: She did not bring it. She did not fetch.

known_facts.fact: She lies across every door now that has somebody behind it.
known_facts.evidence: the way she lay across every door now that had somebody behind it.

known_facts.fact: She watched the lymer go down behind the grey cloaks and did not make a sound.
known_facts.evidence: Ash watched the lymer go down the path behind them, and did not make a sound

known_facts.fact: She came down the Steps at the Captain's side on the edge where the drop was, so that she was between him and it, and nobody told her to.
known_facts.evidence: at the edge where the drop was, so that she was between him and it, and nobody had told her to do that either.

relationships.label: sleeps with her leg across his boot
relationships.note: She bit him through the thumb in the kennel run, then lay down with her splinted leg across his boot and slept.
